headline: Tencent's hy4 hits 17.9%, Xiaomi surges 3.5 points in a day
summary: Tencent's hy4-preview-20260827 extended its all-time token-share record to 17.9% (day 2 of the streak), while Xiaomi jumped five ranks to #5 with a massive single-day gain of 3.5 percentage points. Google's fresh gemini-3.8-flash entry landed at #9 with 3.0%, and four new models debuted across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. MiniMax took a brutal hit, shedding 3.6 points in 24 hours.
highlights: Tencent/hy4-preview-20260827 at 17.9% token share (day 2 of record streak)
Xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-20260422 jumped from rank 6 to rank 5, +3.5 percentage points in one day
Google/gemini-3.8-flash-20260902 debuts at rank 9 with 3.0% share (all-time record for this model)
Top 3 providers (Tencent, DeepSeek, OpenAI) hold 50.4% combined
MiniMax collapsed -3.6 percentage points day-over-day; two of its models dropped out
Four new entrants: anthropic/claude-4.5-haiku, openai/gpt-4o-mini, and two Google Gemini variants
